correctness.rationale: In the specified unordered smooth coefficient chart over C and a+b!=0, u=(a+b)/4, v=(ab+4)/(a+b) transform the supplied involution into (u,v)->(-1/u,-v). Writing q=u-1/u,z=u+1/u,t=v^2,w=vz gives invariant ring C[q,t,w]/(w^2-t(q^2+4)); localization by t-4 and q^2+4-2w+t preserves invariants and removes fixed points. On projectivization W^2 Z=T(Q^2+4Z^2), the four exact partials show only affine q=+/-2i nodes and infinity [0:1:0:0]; completing square gives A3. Setting boundary N=0 yields (w-q^2-4)^2=0, and the contact with t=4 has length four. Symbolically rederived gradient (-2QT,-Q^2-4Z^2,2WZ,W^2-8TZ) and the infinity analytic A3 identity.
